title: Bee Removal White Plains NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in White Plains, NY. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, soffits, and ground. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest removal throughout White Plains and Westchester County. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from wall voids, attics, soffits, eaves, and structural wood — wherever stinging insects have established a colony. We serve every White Plains neighborhood, from downtown to the residential areas near Battle Hill and beyond.
whyUs: With over a decade of experience serving Westchester County, Best Pest Control NYC combines rapid response times with humane bee removal techniques that protect both your property and local bee populations. Our team is fully licensed, insured, and trained in the latest safe extraction methods, ensuring complete removal without harmful chemicals.
localContext: White Plains properties — from historic homes near Court Street to modern condos downtown and single-family residences near Rochambeau Park — commonly experience wasp and hornet nesting activity during warmer months. The city's mix of urban development and green spaces like Tibbets Brook Park creates ideal conditions for yellow jacket colonies to establish themselves in wall voids, attics, outdoor structures, and ground burrows. Eaves and soffits on older homes near Battle Hill are frequent targets for paper wasp and bald-faced hornet nests.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in White Plains?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my White Plains property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most White Plains nest removal requests. Our team understands the urgency when a wasp or yellow jacket nest is near an entry door, deck, or inside a wall void, and we prioritize rapid response throughout Westchester County.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in White Plains?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you remove in White Plains?
faqs.answer: We treat and remove nests from wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, bald-faced hornets, paper wasps, carpenter bees, ground-nesting bees, and bumble bees — all the stinging insects commonly found in Westchester County wall voids, attics, soffits, structural wood, and ground burrows. Our technicians identify the species and locate the nest entry point before beginning treatment.
